_units: All token prices are per 1M tokens in USD. premium_request_cost is per premium request.
_format: pricing_periods is sorted newest-first. Each period has an effective_from date (YYYY-MM-DD). Lookup: find the first period where effective_from <= api_call_timestamp. Each period contains FULL pricing for all models known at that time.
